screens.title: Doctor opens Day care
screens.integration_note: Counts and readiness labels follow returned SQL; no treatment clearance is inferred.

screens.title: Compare visits in a table
screens.integration_note: v2 is the latest available image. The journey names v3, but no v3 image was supplied.

screens.title: Search authorized patients
screens.integration_note: Authorized display selection uses returned patient IDs; name is not an identity join.

screens.title: Establish the patient context
screens.integration_note: ABHA and consent badges appear only when governed data supports them. Source dates retain their zone.

screens.title: Inspect structured facts and provenance
screens.integration_note: Source links and expanded provenance consume returned facts; normalized values are not invented.

screens.title: Read the record chronology
screens.integration_note: Three-clock sorting is implemented; historical rule reconstruction requires backend snapshots.

screens.title: Inspect received and expected documents
screens.integration_note: Received files and expected records remain separate; preliminary is not automatically superseded.

screens.title: Trace the platelet check to its source
screens.integration_note: Propagate verified source_spans to populate the implemented exact excerpt.

screens.title: Read coverage without hiding disagreement
screens.integration_note: Benefit amounts and reconciled dates are not invented when missing from the response.

screens.title: Compare the disagreeing authorization sources
screens.integration_note: Structured and source values remain side by side, with supplied span coordinates and clocks.

screens.title: Prepare the bounded follow-up
screens.integration_note: Task draft is unsaved until submitted; cancel performs no write.

screens.title: Confirm the recorded follow-up
screens.integration_note: Success is shown only for confirmed receipt/read-back. Task save does not change readiness.

screens.title: See follow-up work and its evidence state
screens.integration_note: Board groups actual task states; unresolved SQL checks remain after a task closes.

screens.title: Follow the next-day evidence update
screens.integration_note: Before/after rule comparison consumes optional validated changes; absent history is stated explicitly.

screens.title: Open the copilot in patient context
screens.integration_note: Patient/reference scopes remain separate; reference browsing needs a supplied viewer endpoint.

screens.title: Verify the copilot's answer
screens.integration_note: Only a validated typed artifact is exposed. Raw model prose stays hidden.

screens.title: Handle a clinical-judgment question
screens.integration_note: The packet preview is explicitly a draft at the answer cutoff. Final persisted contents belong to the server.

screens.title: Prepare a family bring-list
screens.integration_note: Bring-list uses returned expected records. Only headings have reviewed translations; this limitation is visible.

screens.title: Read the updated patient snapshot
screens.integration_note: No image was supplied. Checked against the prompt and journey: new cutoff, superseded letter, unchanged platelet issue.

screens.title: Continue with the next patient
screens.integration_note: No image was supplied. Prior Visits view/filter restoration is verified; no fake completion banner is added.

screens.title: Recover safely when data or access changes
screens.integration_note: Fallback reference is the prior failure sheet. Actual recovery is shown in the appropriate context, not as simultaneous demo panels.

screens.title: Review on tablet and phone
screens.integration_note: Fallback reference is the prior responsive sheet. Phone source reading is additionally captured and tested.

scope: frontend; backend integration owned by user team
